environment: Local Wrangler Pages preview, http://localhost:3000; Docusaurus 3.10.2
agent: Codex subagents using inherited session model; no explicit model override
method: Fresh fork_turns:none agents, no inherited conversation, repository/source/plan access prohibited. Read-only HTTP documentation tasks. Two runs per scenario, plus two homepage-only discovery runs. Qualitative evidence, not cross-provider certification.

automated_checks.baseline_comparison: Article text (excluding View as Markdown), canonical URLs, and robots tags unchanged.
automated_checks.release_simulation: Actual docs:version v0.28.0 in temporary copy; v0.27.0 moved under version path; v0.24.0 removed; seeded stale outputs removed by clean build; v0.28 unified-gateway and v0.27 provider-route content remain distinct.
automated_checks.runtime: Unit tests also checked on Node 22 (CI runtime).

limitations: Released Docker source uses mutable :latest and contains a :main Local-owner example labeled unreleased. Export preserves this source inconsistency; no snapshots edited.
Older auth-scope source retains MCP-server terminology and does not explicitly establish vMCP-specific selection.
Production Cloudflare bot/WAF access has not been verified; no Cloudflare account configuration was changed.
These results concern the tested agents, not all OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini clients.
evidence_status: Historical qualitative summary, not independently rescorable: full answers, answer citations, and exact model identifier were not retained. Counts describe the original run, not the current test suite. Do not infer complete content fidelity or cross-provider certification.
